raw_text:
**Council role:** Architect (design risks/integration), Analyst (requirements/gaps), Implementer (code/fixes), or Reviewer (quality). Roles coordinate; all agents are fungible generalists.

Work from `<REDACTED_USERPATH>/agent-marketplace-demo/`. ALWAYS use `bd` from this project directory. Read AGENTS.md and README.md; register with Agent Mail, introduce yourself, check inbox. Always check Agent Mail between tasks and communicate your work. Run:
cd <REDACTED_USERPATH>/agent-marketplace-demo
bv --robot-triage
bv --robot-next
bv --robot-plan
bv --robot-insights | jq '.Cycles'
bv --robot-insights | jq '.bottlenecks'
Never run bare `bv` — it launches interactive TUI that blocks. Pick a useful bead; message `[bd-XXX] Starting task description` (Thread ID `bd-XXX`), mention reserved files, mark `in_progress`.

Always reserve files before editing:
file_reservation_paths \
project_key="<REDACTED_USERPATH>/agent-marketplace-demo" \
agent_name="YourAgentName" \
paths=["src/components/AgentCanvas.tsx"] \
After work:
release_file_reservations \
project_key="<REDACTED_USERPATH>/agent-marketplace-demo" \
agent_name="YourAgentName"

Use strict TypeScript (no `any`), React hooks, React Three Fiber (`useFrame`, `useThree`), `InstancedMesh` for 100+ identical sprites, sprite sheets, LOD, pixel-perfect `renderer.setPixelRatio(1, 1)`; shadcn/ui. FastAPI async, Pydantic, LangGraph (`perceive`, `reason`, `act`), TypedDict, LangChain OpenAI, type hints, async I/O, batch agents. No `console.log`; no hardcoded values; handle errors; profile before optimizing; test critical paths.

Self-review new code repeatedly, fixing bugs until none remain. Review peers’ code deeply; diagnose root causes and fix as needed. Then mark bead `done`, release reservations, send `[bd-XXX] Completed`, respond to messages. Commit changed files in logically connected groupings with detailed messages, then push. Don't edit the code at all. Don't commit obviously ephemeral files.

Always work from `<REDACTED_USERPATH>/agent-marketplace-demo/`; always reserve files before editing; always check Agent Mail between tasks; always self-review before marking bead done; always communicate work; never skip quality checks.

When ending a session, MUST complete all: file issues for follow-up; run tests/linters/builds if code changed; update issue status; run `git pull --rebase` then `git status  # MUST show "up to date with origin"`; clean stashes/prune remote branches; verify all changes committed and pushed; hand off context. Work is NOT complete until `git push` succeeds. NEVER stop before pushing. NEVER say "ready to push when you are" — YOU must push. If push fails, resolve and retry until it succeeds.
